After changing hyperscale firewall policies, it may take longer than expected for the policy changes to be applied to traffic. The delay occurs because the hyperscale firewall policy engine enhancements added to FortiOS may cause the FortiGate to take extra time to compile firewall policy changes and generate a new policy set that can be applied to traffic by NP7 processors. The delay is affected by hyperscale policy set complexity, the total number of established sessions to be re-evaluated, and the rate of receiving new sessions.

In FIPS-CC mode, if cfg-save is set to revert, the system will halt a configuration change or certificate purge.
In some cases, the HA SNMP OID responds very slowly or does work correctly.
Traffic loss occurs when running SNAT PBA pool in a hyperscale VDOM. The NP7 hardware module PRP got stuck, which caused the NP7 to hang.
DoS policy ID cannot be moved in GUI and CLI when enabling multiple DoS policies.
Kernel panic occurs after traffic goes through IPsec VPN tunnel and EMAC VLAN interface.
Get root.firewall.service.custom... configuration error after upgrading or changing LAN extension to traffic VDOM.
NP7 platforms may encounter a kernel panic when deleting more than two hardware switches at the same time.
Slow upload speeds when connected to FIOS connection. Affected platforms: NP6Lite and NP6xLite.

When creating an inner VLAN CAPWAP interface or sending inner VLAN traffic when the FortiGate is rebooting/upgrading from capwap-offload disable status, these actions trigger a freeze. Affected platforms: NP7 models.
Running get system performance status does not update the data.
The ifLastChange SNMP OID only shows zeros.
There is no 1000auto option under the ports. Affected platforms: FG-110xE.
1G copper SFP port is always up on FG-260xF.
LTE fails to connect after the firewall reboots. Multiple reboots are required to bring back connectivity.
PPPoE is not working on FG-60E wan2 interface.
Polling fgfwpolid returns disabled policies.

When pushing a script from FortiManager to FortiGate, FortiOS will sometimes send the CLI change to FortiManager with the FGFM API. If the tunnel is not up, the session will not exist and it causes a code crash.
CMDB checksum is not updated when a certificate is renewed over CMP, causing a FortiManager failure to synchronize with the certificate.
The cid process is consuming high memory, and the FortiGate enters conserve mode.
The reply-to option in the email server settings is no longer visible in a default server configuration on FortiOS 7.2.0.
DoS policy with custom service does not work as expected on a PPPoE interface.
Get disk error message after changing disk usage to wanopt.
Null pointer causing kernel crash on FWF-61F.
FortiGate may not provide detailed information during a watchdog-initiated reboot.
Unable to resolve sp***.saas.ap***.com on a specific VDOM.
As the size of the internet service database expands, ffdb_err_msg_print: ret=-4, Error: kernel error is observed frequently on 32-bit CPU platforms, such as the FG-100E.
Constant increase (3%-4%) in memory occurs everyday.
HQIP memory test failed and triggered a log out with a newcli process crash.
The cmdbsvr process may crash when there are many addresses and address groups that include each other recursively.
Random kernel panic may occur due to an incorrect address calculation for the internet service entry's IP range.
Signature updating from FortiManager does not work after cloud communication is disabled.
High fcnacd usage occurs and unable to retrieve EMS information from the FortiGate CLI.
FortiGate becomes unresponsive, and there are many WAD and forticron crashes.
Kernel panic occurs due to VXLAN.
When the uplink modem is restarted, the FortiGate interface configured as PPPoE is unable to obtain an IP address.
Unable to remove DDNS entry frequently, even if the DDNS setting is disabled.
Kernel panics occurs on secondary HA node on NP7 models (7.0.6).
FG-4400F setting speed of 40000full on QSFP port is not applied at the NIC level.
Unexpected device reboots with the kernel panic error on NP7 models.
When deleting a non-existing entry, the error code returned is not appropriate.
Burst in multicast packets is causing high CPU usage on multiple CPU cores.
Trusted hosts are not working correctly in FortiOS 7.2.1.
DoS anomaly has incorrect threshold after loading a modified configuration file.
Running get system auto-update versions causes newcli to crash and the prints quit at the MAC address database.
Random kernel panic occurs and causes the device to reboot.
The GUI and API stopped working after loading many interfaces due to httpsd stuck in a D state (kernel I/O socket).
IPS and application control is causing the FortiGate (VWP) to change either the source MAC address or the destination MAC address based on the flow.
FG-3700D unexpectedly reboots after the COMLog reported a kernel panic due to an IPv6 failure to set up the master session for the expectation session under some conditions.

Kernel panic and regular reboots occur on NP7 platforms, which are caused by FortiOS trying to offload a receiving ESP packet from the EMAC VLAN interface and convert to an IPv6 destination address with NAT46 NPU offloaded sessions.
Can't find xitem. Drop the response. error appears for DHCPOFFER packets in the DHCP relay debug.
Unexpected console error appears: unregister_netdevice: waiting for pim6reg1 to become free. Usage count = 3.
DHCP relay does not work properly with two DHCP relay servers configured.
Remote access management from a FortiManager login fails if trusted hosts are configured for the administrator account.
Huge configuration files cause delays during the booting process.
Network device kernel null pointer is causing a kernel crash.
Issue with the server_host_key_algorithm compatibility when using SSH on SolarWinds.
There may be a race condition between the CMDB initializing and the customer language file loading, which causes the customer language file to be removed after upgrading.
Random reboots and kernel panic on NP7 cluster when the FortiGate sends a TCP RST packet and IP options are missing in the header.
The FortiGate is only offering the ssh-ed25519 algorithm for an SSH connection.
The 40G/100G port goes down on FG-260xF when upgrading to 7.2.
GUI displays a blank page if vdom-admin user has partial permissions.
Subnet overlap error occurs when configuring the same IPv4 link-local addresses on two different interfaces.
Link lights on the FG-1100E fail to come up and are inoperative after upgrading.
Observed Node exiting due to unhandled rejection error messages in crash log after upgrading to 7.2.1.
Upgrading from 7.0.5 (split-VDOM mode) to 7.2.0 converts to multi-VDOM). Certificates are not exported in the backup configuration.
Traffic counters in diagnose sys modem history become empty after upgrading from 6.4.

The endpoint-control fctems entry 0 is added after upgrading from 6.4 to 7.0.8 when the FortiGate does not have EMS server, which means the endpoint-control fctems feature was not enabled previously. This leads to a FortiManager installation failure.
The FortiGate will not send a MAC-based authentication RADIUS authentication request for one of the devices on the network.
The samld process is killed if the SP certificate set has an ECC 384-bit public key.
Remote RADIUS user password change does not work if password encoding is ISO-8859-1 on the FortiGate.
Unable to create a new guest user if its ID is the ASCII code of a character that is the name of a local user.
The srchwvendor, devtype, srcfamily, osname, and srchwversion log fields are not populated properly if the devices are behind a router or proxy.
When multiple FSSO CA connections are configured at the same time, only the last configured FSSO connection comes up.
When a device is detected as vulnerable, its source is not set and the inventory query quits.
FortiGate is adding the same LDAP server in the list of LDAP servers to try twice in fnbamd.
Subject Alternative Name (SAN) is missing from the certificate upon automatic certificate renewal made by the FortiGate.

After a few days, some devices are not displayed in the Users & Devices > Device Inventory widget and WiFi & Switch Controller > FortiSwitch Ports page's Device Information column due to a mismatch in the device count between the following commands. diagnose user device list
The Device detection option is missing in the GUI for redundant interfaces (CLI is OK).
A User device store query error (error code: -1) warning appears on the Asset Identity Center page.
RADIUS Access Request message needs to be sent when the client reconnects during firewall authentication session expiration.
Unknown CA issue can be bypassed when connecting Fortinet hosted servers.
The device identification scanner crashes due to delayed fragments.
RADIUS re-authentication is not following RFC 2865 standards.
Incorrect source MAC address is used in LLDP TX packet when the interface has https in allowaccess.
LLDP packets are not being received if mgmt is used as an HA management reservation interface.
FortiToken purge in a VDOM clears all FortiToken statuses in the system.
The cid process crashes when cloning of 60000 security policies.
Adding a local user to a group containing many users causes a delay in GUI and CLI due to cmdbsvr (high CPU).
RADIUS MAC authentication using ClearPass is intermittently using old credentials.
FortiToken activation emails should include HTTPS links to documentation instead of HTTP.
Some embedded SSL certificates entered the Error state after enabling FIPS-CC.
The EAP proxy worker application crashes frequently.
A cid scan crash occurs when device detections happen in a certain order.
IPv6 traffic triggers <interface>: hw csum failure message on CLI console.
Traffic/session logging incorrectly refers to SR-IOV secondary interfaces when the Rx is from fast path.
Dynamic address objects are removed after Azure API call failed and caused legitimate traffic drop.
Every time the FortiGate reboots, the certificate setting reverts to self-sign under config system ftm-push.
SFTP backup not working with Azure storage account.
Unable to enable FIPS cipher mode on FG-VM-ARM64-AWS.
VPNs over Oracle Cloud stop processing traffic.
Problem accessing some web servers when WAF and AV are enabled in same policy (proxy inspection mode).

The WAF is indicating malformed request false positives caused by incorrect setups of four known headers: Access-Control-Max-Age, Access-Control-Allow-Headers, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, and Origin.
System events logs randomly contain a msg=UrlBwl-black gzopen fail message.
FGSP cluster with UTM blocks websites when NTurbo or offloading is enabled.
Support matching IPv4 mapped IPv6 hostnames in the URL filter.
Web filter is not logging all URLs properly.
Unrated is displayed, even if the system language is set to Japanese when the policy inspection mode is set to flow.
Duplicate agent field in web content block log.
FortiOS exhibits segmentation fault on hostapd on the secondary controller configured in HA.
FortiGate is not sending RADIUS accounting message consistently to RADIUS server for wireless SSO.
CAPWAP traffic is dropped when capwap-offload is enabled.
Configuration installation from FortiManager breaks the quarantine setting, and the VAP becomes undeletable.
FG-1800F drops wireless client traffic in L2 tunneled VLAN with capwap-offload enabled.
Wireless multicast traffic causes the cw_acd process to have high CPU usage and triggers a hostapd crash.
Suggest replacing the IP Address column with MAC Address in the Collected Email widget.
CAPWAP data traffic over redundant IPsec tunnels failing when the primary IPsec tunnel is down (failover to backup tunnel).
Connectivity loss occurs due to switch and FortiAPs (hostapd crash).
Application hostapd crash found on FG-101F.
The cw_acd process crashes several times after the system enters conserve mode.
A hostapd process crash is shown in device crash logs.
Wireless client shows portal related webpage while doing MAC authentication with MAB mode.

CAPWAP daemon (cw_acd) experiences a signal 11 crash when reconnecting a FortiAP to the FortiGate, and the FortiGate does not populate SA scan data on radio0 and radio1 of 231G when starting the SA from the FortiGate GUI.
The cw_acd process is deleting dynamic IPsec tunnels on the secondary device, which causes the FortiAPs to disconnect on the primary device.
Dynamic VLAN assignment is disabled in the GUI when editing an SSID with radius mac-auth and dynamic-vlan enabled.
FortiAP goes through DTLS_SETUP for standby session when the ACD count is set to multicore.
The voice-enterprise value changed after upgrading.
HA FortiGate encounters multiple hostapd crashes.
Hostapd segmentation fault signal 6 occurs upon HA failover.
Hostapd segmentation fault signal 11 occurs upon RF chamber setup.
The cw_acd process appears to be stuck, and is sending several access requests for MAC authentication.
Invalid wireless MAC OUI detected for a valid client on the network.
Wireless client gets disconnect from WiFi if it is connected to a WPA2 SSID more than 12 hours.
Proxy policy disclaimer is not working, even when there is no url-map="/" configured on the access proxy.
WAD re-challenges user authentication upon HA failover.
Support the browser version in the firewall proxy-address settings for the user agent.
FortiAuthenticator Cloud zero trust tunnel (ZTNA connection) fails when EMS Fabric connector is configured.

The EMS tag name (defined in the EMS server's Zero Trust Tagging Rules) format changed in 7.2.1 from FCTEMS<serial_number>_<tag_name> to EMS<id>_ZTNA_<tag_name>. After upgrading from 7.2.0 to 7.2.1, the EMS tag format was converted properly in the CLI configuration, but the WAD daemon is unable to recognize this new format, so the ZTNA traffic will not match any ZTNA policies with EMS tag name checking enabled.
An offline FortiClient should be immediately rejected by ZTNA.

ZTNA TCP forwarding is not working when a real server is configured with an FQDN address type. An FQDN address type that can resolve public IPs is not recommended for ZTNA TCP forwarding on real servers because the defined internal DNS database zone is trying to override it at the same time. By doing so, the internal private address may not take effect after rebooting, and causes a ZTNA TCP forwarding failure due to the real server not being found.
ZTNA server (access proxy VIP) is causing all interfaces that receive ARP request to reply with their MAC address.
An error case occurs in WAD when a client EMS tag changes.
Mark as Reject can be still chosen as an Action in a block/allow list in the GUI.
FortiGate sends too many unnecessary requests to FortiSandbox and causes high resource usage.
On the Security Profiles > AntiVirus page, a VDOM administrator with a custom administrator profile cannot create or modify an antivirus profile belonging to the VDOM.
observations.workaround: set the VDOM administrator profile to super_admin.

observations.description: When there are many users authenticated by an explicit proxy policy, the Firewall Users widget can take a long time to load. This issue does not impact explicit proxy functionality.
Unexpected behavior occurs when configuring internet services with custom or ISDB entries, leading to failed negate options and issues with internet-service6 functionality.

The proxy-re-authentication-mode option has been removed in 7.2.4 and is replaced with proxy-keep-alive-mode re-authentication. The new proxy-re-authentication-time timer is associated with this re-authentication mode. There are two unresolved issues: After upgrading, the previously configured proxy-auth-timeout value for the absolute re-authentication mode is not preserved in the new proxy-re-authentication-time.
In some cases, the explicit proxy policy list can take a long time to load due to a delay in retrieving the proxy statistics. This issue does not impact explicit proxy functionality.
observations.workaround: restart the WAD process, or temporarily disable the WAD debugging process (when FortiGate reboots, this process will need to be disabled again). diagnose wad toggle (use direct connect diagnose)

observations.description: Post-upgrade, explicit proxy policies may mismatch when an HTTP CONNECT request or TLS SNI of a HTTPS session partially matches to a policy with deep inspection enabled.

On the Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy page in 6.4.0 onwards, the IPv4 and IPv6 policy tables are combined but the custom section name (global label) is not automatically checked for duplicates. If there is a duplicate custom section name, the policy list may show empty for that section. This is a display issue only and does not impact policy traffic.
observations.workaround: rename the custom section to unique name between IPv4 and IPv6 policies.

observations.description: In the Policy & Objects menu, the firewall, DoS, and traffic shaping policy pages take around five seconds to load when the FortiGate cannot reach the FortiGuard DNS servers.
observations.workaround: set the DNS server to the FortiGuard DNS server.

observations.description: If the first firewall service object in the service list (based on the order in the command line table) has a protocol type of IP, the GUI may incorrectly modify its protocol number whenever a new firewall service of the same protocol type IP is created in the GUI. This silent misconfiguration can result in unexpected behavior of firewall policies that use the impacted service. For example, some 6K and 7K platforms have firewall service ALL (protocol type IP) as the first service, and this can cause the ALL service to be modified unexpectedly.
observations.workaround: create a new service in the CLI, or move a non-IP type services to the top of the firewall service list. For example, if ALL is the first firewall service in the list: config firewall service custom edit "unused" set tcp-portrange 1 next move "unused" before "ALL" end

observations.description: FG-3000D cluster kernel panic occurs when upgrading from 7.0.5 to 7.0.6 and later.
Increased CPU usage in softirq after upgrading from 7.0.5 to 7.0.6.
When the service protocol is an IP with no specific port, it is skipped to be cached and causes a protocol/port service name in the log.
Unexpected behavior in WAD caused by enabling HTTP/2 while usingvirtual servers.
observations.workaround: under config firewall vip, set http-supported-max-version to http1.

observations.description: Access to some websites fails after upgrading to FortiOS 7.2.3 when the firewall policy is in flow-based inspection mode.
observations.workaround: access is possible with one of the following settings. Change the firewall policy inspection mode to proxy-based. Remove the IPS security profile from the firewall policy. Set tcp-mss-sender and tcp-mss-receiver in the firewall policy to 1300. Set tcp-mss to 1300 on the VPN tunnel interface. Bypass the inter-VDOM link (may work in applicable scenarios, such as if the VDOM default route points to physical interface instead of an inter-VDOM).

observations.description: On the Network > Interfaces page when VDOM mode is enabled, the Global view incorrectly shows the status of IPsec tunnel interfaces from non-management VDOMs as up. The VDOM view shows the correct status.
The FortiGate may display a false alarm message TypeError [ERR_INVALID_URL]: Invalid URL in the crashlog for the node process. This error does not affect the operation of the GUI.
When viewing entries in the slide-out window of the Policy & Objects > Internet Service Database page, users cannot scroll down to the end if there are over 100000 entries.
On the Network > Routing Objects page, editing a prefix list with a large number of rule entries fails with an error notification that The integer value is not within valid range.
observations.workaround: edit a prefix list with a large number of rule entries in the CLI.

observations.description: When private data encryption is enabled, the GUI may become unresponsive and HA may fail to synchronize the configuration.

In the System > Administrators dialog, when there are a lot of VDOMs (over 200), the dialog can take more than one minute to load the Two-factor Authentication toggle. This issue does not affect configuring other settings in the dialog.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to configure two-factor-authentication under config system admin.

observations.description: When private data encryption is enabled, all passwords present in the configuration fail to load and may cause HA failures.
After successfully changing the VLAN ID of an interface from the CLI, an error message similar to cmdb_txn_cache_data(query=log.npu-server,leve=1) failed may appear.
IPv6 traffic fails to load balance across multiple virtual domains when using Equal-cost Multipath (ECMP) in NAT mode on FortiGate devices.
The nat64-force-ipv4-packet-forwarding command is missing under config system npu.
The npu-session list fails to display policy-route information when traffic is routed through a policy route on FortiGate models using NPU acceleration.
The "diagnose sys npu-session list" command displays incorrect policy IDs when traffic uses intra-zone policies.
If a tunnel in an IPsec aggregate is down but its DPD link is on, the IPsec aggregate interface may still forward traffic to a down tunnel causing traffic to drop.
In an HA cluster, static routes via the IPsec tunnel interface are not inactive in the routing table when the tunnel is down.
observations.workaround: in an SD-WAN scenario, a health check for the IPsec tunnel (SD-WAN member) with update-static-route enable is required. config system sdwan config health-check edit <name> set server <address> next

observations.description: The IPsec VPN tunnel list can take more than 10 seconds to load if the FortiGate has large number of tunnels, interfaces, policies, and addresses. This is a GUI display issue and does not impact tunnel operation.
When viewing logs on the Log & Report > System Events page, filtering by domain\username does not display matching entries.
observations.workaround: use a double backslash (domain\\username) while filtering or searching by username only without the domain

observations.description: FortiClient does not send the public IP address for SAML, resulting in 0.0.0.0 being shown in FortiOS and SASE.
IPv6 VRRP backup is sending RA that causes routing issue.
When there are multiple routes in the link monitor, they are not withdrawn from the routing table when the link monitor is not functioning as expected.
Link monitor's probe timeout value range is not appropriate when the user decreases the minimum interval.
The Network dashboard may not load if the administrator disables SD-WAN Interface under System > Feature Visibility.
observations.workaround: enable SD-WAN Interface under System > Feature Visibility, or remove the SD-WAN widget from the Network dashboard.

observations.description: On the Security Fabric > Security Rating page, security rating test for FortiAnalyzer fails when connected to FortiAnalyzer Cloud.
On a FortiGate that has large tables (over 1000 firewall policies, address, or other tables for example), security rating reports may cause the FortiGate to go into conserve mode.

When the Security Fabric is enabled and admin-https-redirection is enabled on a downstream FortiGate, the following GUI features do not work for the downstream FortiGate when the administrator manages the downstream FortiGate using the root FortiGate's GUI: Web console access Diagnostic packet capture GUI notification when a new device joins or leaves the Security Fabric GUI notification if a configuration on the current page changes These features still work for the root FortiGate's GUI.
observations.workaround: disable admin-https-redirection on the downstream FortiGate.

observations.description: GUI performance limitation - Security Fabric physical and logical topology is slow to load when there are a lot of downstream devices including FortiGates, ForriSwitches, FortiAPs and endpoint device traffic. This is a GUI only display issue and does not impact operations of downstream devices.
FortiClient Windows cannot be launched with SSL VPN web portal.

When a FortiSwitch port is reconfigured, the FortiGate may incorrectly retain old detected device data from the port that results in an unexpected number of detected device MACs for the port. Using diagnose switch-controller mac-cache show to check the device data can result in the Device Information column being blank on the WiFi & Switch Controller > FortiSwitch Ports page or in the Assets widget.
observations.workaround: disable the device retention cache to remove old device data. config switch-controller global set mac-retention-period 0 end

observations.description: Security rating shows an incorrect warning for unregistered FortiSwitches on the WiFi & Switch Controller > Managed FortiSwitches.
observations.workaround: select a FortiSwitch and use the Diagnostics & Tools tooltip to view the correct registration status.

observations.description: Interface belonging to other VDOMs should be removed from interface list when configuring a GENEVE interface.
High memory usage occurs on FG-200F.
High CPU utilization occurs when relay is enabled on VLAN, which prevents users from getting an IP from DHCP.
When configuring an 802.3ad aggregate interface with a 1 Gbps speed, the port's LED is off and traffic cannot pass through. Affected platforms: 110xE, 220xE, 330xE, 340xE, and 360xE.
FortiGate might enter conserve mode if disk logging is enabled and log-traffic all is set in a policy.
Kernel panic occurs due to null pointer dereference.
When a user is logged in as a VDOM administrator with restricted access and tries to upload a certificate (System > Certificates), the Create button on the Create Certificate pane is grayed out.
Status light is not showing on the FortiGate 60F or 100F after a cold and warm reboot.
The kernel 4.19 cannot concurrently reassemble IPv4 fragments for a source IP with more than 64 destination IP addresses.

Upgrading FortiOS firmware with a local file from 6.2.13, 6.4.12, 7.0.11, or 7.2.4 and earlier may fail for certain models because the image file size exceeds the upload limit. Affected models: FortiGate 6000 and 7000 series, FWF-80F-2R, and FWF-81F-2R-POE.
observations.workaround: upgrade the firmware using FortiGuard, or manually increase the HTTP request size limit to 200MB. config system global set http-request-limit 200000000 end

observations.description: When upgrading multiple firmware versions in the GUI, the Follow upgrade path option does not respect the recommended upgrade path.
When a search is performed on a user (User & Authentication > User Definition page), the search results highlight all the groups the user belongs to.
FortiGate 81F 802.1X MAC authentication bypass (MAB) failed to authenticate Cisco AP.
FG-ARM64-GCP and FG-ARM64-AZURE have HA synchronization issue with internal IP after failover.
Kernel hangs on FG-VM64-AZURE.
If FGTVM was deployed in UEFI boot mode, do not downgrade to any GA version earlier than 7.2.4.
VLAN traffic fails to pass through E810-XXV NIC with SFP28 transceiver and 25G speed after enabling DPDK.
Block replacement page is not pushed automatically to replace the video content when using a video filter.
HTTP sessions are logged as HTTPS in web filter logs when using an HTTP VIP server, causing incorrect protocol identification.

When there are extra large number of managed FortiAP devices (over 500) and large number of WiFi clients (over 5000), the Managed FortiAPs page and FortiAP Status widget can take a long time to load. This issue does not impact FortiAP operation.
The layer 3 roaming feature may not work when the wireless controller is running multiple cw_ acd processes (when the value of acd-process-count is not zero).
In HA cluster of FGT-200F units with 'capwap-offload' enabled, traffic from tunnel SSID cannot pass after HA failover is triggered.
The automatically connect option fails to function when the local radio connection is lost on some FortiGate models.
Unable to create FortiAP profile in the GUI for dual-5G mode FortiAP U231F/U431F models.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to update the profile to dual-5G mode.
